verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes the KYAPay token protocol as an 'open, industry specification' with documented token types, headers, and API reference pages (charge-token, introspect-token), and a probe confirms the live API enforces key-gating as documented. However, there is no evidence of a versioned schema, a formal spec document, or conformance/validation tooling — an OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, and no test suite, SDK conformance checker, or protocol version number is documented. missing for 10: published machine-readable schema (OpenAPI/JSON Schema), explicit protocol versioning, conformance/validation test tooling, independent corroboration of spec adherence.
